hints: Which of these four objects has corners?
Round objects have no straight parts at all — count how many objects don't fit that description.

canonical: Check each object's boundary: the football, the bangle, and the coin are all round, with no corners.
Only the matchbox has straight edges and corners — that's 1 out of the 4 objects.

stem: Ravi is sorting a football, a bangle, a coin, and a matchbox by their boundary. Three of these have a boundary that is curved all the way round. How many of the four objects have a boundary made of straight lines and corners instead?
